criteria.label: Problem
criteria.instructions: How concrete and consequential is the problem?

criteria.label: Insight
criteria.instructions: Does the narrative contain a non-obvious insight?

criteria.label: Solution
criteria.instructions: How clearly does the proposed solution follow from the problem?

criteria.label: Traction
criteria.instructions: Is there concrete evidence of traction?

criteria.label: Advantage
criteria.instructions: How defensible is the described advantage?

criteria.label: Ask
criteria.instructions: Is the desired next action explicit?

criteria.label: Coherence
criteria.instructions: How coherent is the narrative from problem to ask?
